contractCoverage.reason: No such product surface belongs to this Slack adapter change.

surfaceEvidence.detail: All five real gateway socket cases passed.
17 of 20 adapter tests passed; three demonstrated blockers.

adversarialCases.scenario: throwing handlers ack first, retries dedupe, malformed frames survive and disconnect reconnects
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Ack before handler; handler failure does not poison later dispatch; retry dedupes; invalid/missing-id frames do not dispatch; disconnect creates second socket.

adversarialCases.scenario: hostile timestamps never emit non-platform message ids
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: All six hostile timestamps drop before chat.send; subsequent valid message has a protocol-safe id.

adversarialCases.scenario: foreign reply target is a definitive delivery failure, never thread_ts
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Foreign-channel reply target must fail definitively before postMessage, per brief line 11; it must never become thread_ts.

adversarialCases.scenario: literal mentions in code count; entities decode once and broadcasts normalize
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Brief literal text-contains rule includes code-span mentions; normalize broadcasts and subteam labels; decode entities exactly once.

adversarialCases.scenario: fifty-thousand-character fenced text has bounded balanced chunks
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: 50k fenced message produces pieces <=4000 characters with balanced fences.

adversarialCases.scenario: file-only body survives and empty body drops
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: File-only message renders attachment body; message without files or text drops.

adversarialCases.scenario: own, hidden, every skipped subtype, unchanged/empty edits and app_mention never send
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Own user, own bot_id, hidden, all SKIPPED_SUBTYPES, unchanged/empty edits and app_mention cause no gateway requests.

adversarialCases.scenario: bot parent mentions; unknown parent omits fromSelf
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Bot-authored parent sets mentioned; missing parent_user_id leaves fromSelf absent.

adversarialCases.scenario: transport failure ambiguous, Slack API failure definitive
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: TypeError produces ambiguous:true, SlackApiError ambiguous:false.

adversarialCases.scenario: all three chunks keep thread and duplicate warning
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Three-chunk thread reply keeps thread_ts on every chunk, prefixes duplicate warning, confirms once.

adversarialCases.scenario: malformed and unknown reactions fail without API; already_reacted confirms
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Malformed target and unknown emojiName fail definitively without reaction API calls. Already-reacted coverage independently verified by RT-SLACK-25.

adversarialCases.scenario: disconnected edit overflow retains newest 256 and replays ordered
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: 300 disconnected edits retain newest 256, log 44 evictions, and replay in order on adoptClient.

adversarialCases.scenario: failed edit remains queued and reconnects for replay
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Failed chat.edit remains pending and schedules reconnect; adopted healthy client replays it.

adversarialCases.scenario: duplicate inbound dedupes but unavailable is forgotten
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Successful message id is not resent; unavailable message is forgotten and retried successfully.

adversarialCases.scenario: newest-first recovery delivers ascending and cannot cross unavailable
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Newest-first paginated history delivers ascending; watermark stops before unavailable message.

adversarialCases.scenario: recovered replies retain thread origin
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Recovered thread reply has thread origin and correct parent/channel id.

adversarialCases.scenario: three-strike quarantine is re-probed after gateway reconnect
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Third permanent failure quarantines; later gateway reconnection/pass must re-probe restored access and clear quarantine.

adversarialCases.scenario: twenty recovery triggers remain single flight
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Twenty concurrent triggers run one pass at a time and coalesce to one follow-up.

adversarialCases.scenario: credential prefixes fail without secrets, relative files resolve and unknown channel keys reject
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Both incorrect token prefixes rejected without secret echo; relative token paths resolve from config; unknown channel key rejected.

adversarialCases.scenario: unconfigured unmentioned Slack channel is context only
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Unconfigured unmentioned channel records no persona turn or delivery.

adversarialCases.scenario: mention-open engages and persona markup is escaped at Slack boundary
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Namespaced mention-open policy engages and literal persona <script>& is escaped at Slack postMessage.

adversarialCases.scenario: check reaction token delivers on Slack and is refused on Telegram
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Persona check token maps to white_check_mark and confirmed Slack delivery; Telegram produces no reaction and explicit chat.react refuses it.

adversarialCases.scenario: monitor and loopback cannot chat.react
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Monitor and loopback chat.react requests fail and leave no delivery rows.

adversarialCases.scenario: thread and channel isolate sessions and route replies
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Thread and channel have distinct session origin records and correctly routed confirmed replies.

adversarialCases.scenario: already_reacted Web API response confirms delivery
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Actual SlackWebApi already_reacted response is treated as success and delivery.confirm is emitted.

adversarialCases.scenario: dist/gajaeway-slack --help
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Real binary --help exits 0 and prints usage without booting.

adversarialCases.scenario: dist/gajaeway-slack --version
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Real binary --version exits 0 and prints semver.

adversarialCases.scenario: dist/gajaeway-slack --nope
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Real binary unknown argument exits 2 and prints usage to stderr.

adversarialCases.scenario: dist/gajaeway-slack
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Real binary refuses second instance with live pidfile, exits 2, does not overwrite pidfile.

blockers.observed: Foreign C2:1.0 reply target posts a top-level C1 reply and confirms instead of definitive failure.

blockers.contractRef: User minimum adversarial case 5; definitive invalid reaction settlement
blockers.observed: Unknown emojiName throws generic Error, classified ambiguous:true; no API was called, so delivery failure should be definitive.

blockers.contractRef: User minimum adversarial case 7; recoverMissedMessages reconnect re-probe promise
blockers.observed: After three missing_scope failures, subsequent pass and gateway reconnect never call history again (3 calls, expected 4). failures>=3 skip occurs before clean-pass clearing; no callback resets counters. Quarantine persists indefinitely, including across restarts via cursor file.

limitations: Parent rebased the branch mid-QA. Original frozen hash run: 24 cases, 21 passed, same three defects. Latest JUnit: 25 cases, 22 passed, same three defects after adapting only new gateway fixture to upstream attachTestBrokerOwnership. Intermediate fixture-drift failures are not attributed to the frozen hash.

Coverage rows enumerate obligations exercised, not all brief obligations: working-status, slash-command authorization, cache eviction and service/doc integration were outside this new minimum red-team suite.
RT-SLACK-17 disables automatic recovery scheduling for deterministic manual passes; source inspection establishes onConnected only triggers scheduler and never resets quarantine.
Gateway teardown emits invalid socket write count: -32 warnings; these are retained, not suppressed.
